pages.text: Some recipes need a $(thing)catalyst$() in an input slot. It is never consumed - JEI marks it in gold. Each catalyst is made from the one before it:

$(li)$(item)Higgs Catalyst$(): mass-altering processes$(li)$(item)Spacetime Catalyst$(): forged from a Higgs Catalyst, for cosmic processors and universe forging$(li)$(item)Eternity Catalyst$(): forged from a Spacetime Catalyst, for the Omega Point and everything beyond

A chemist's catalyst speeds a reaction and comes out unchanged at the end. These behave the same way: present, necessary, never used up. Since each is forged from the one before, I treat the first one as the most precious thing in the lab.
A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Required (not consumed) by mass-altering processes.$(br2)Made in $(item)Higgs Field Modulator$().
A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime. Required (not consumed) by hyperdimensional processes.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().
Time flows through it without passing. Required (not consumed) by the final processes.$(br2)Made in $(item)Reality Compiler$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Higgs Catalyst$(): Dimensional Residue, Spacetime Catalyst, Spin Foam Lattice, Theoretical Notes I$(li)$(item)Spacetime Catalyst$(): Dimensional Residue, Eternity Catalyst, Theoretical Notes II$(li)$(item)Eternity Catalyst$(): Unified Notes II
